What We Need
We are looking for a 
Senior Product Manager 
to join the 2K Product team to work on a new IP. Your role will be to help strategically understand market trends, advocate and ground our decisions in our player, and prioritize what makes a winning title in a competitive gaming landscape. What You Will Do
Closely partner with development and publishing teams to drive, define and deliver product & business strategy for unannounced projects, including:
Collaborate with studio and publishing teams to build Product Needs for in-game features and core gameplay, focused on player engagement, interest, satisfaction and how those relate to business outcomes. Effectively partner with studio and publishing teams to guide and support prioritization, tradeoffs and value. 
Use data, insights (research), and user testing to build a deep understanding of player behaviors, engagement patterns, content preferences, and player trust.
Partner with Monetization and Commercial to connect player satisfaction and business value to create win-win scenarios for both
Define Product imperatives and needs, market fit and testable hypothesis for a both successful game and Live Service updates.
Team up with marketing to connect our product offering to our marketing strategy so we reach the right players with the right promise
Market Intelligence – Deliver research and thought leadership on the industry landscape, trends, competitor products, and recommendations that help us grow and evolve our thinking.
Be the Product Champion – Share insights, processes, and lessons learned with other studio & publishing teams.
Be the Player Advocate – Deeply understand and advocate for the player’s perspective; be their advocate in the room who understands them and speaks up for them to make sure we’re authentically serving our players.

5+ years of experience, including product management, production, live ops, game design, or other related fields within Live Service / Competitive games
Deep understanding of and passion for competitive games, player motivations, and market trends, with the ability to deconstruct what drives successful live games and the risks and opportunities within them
Strong shooter background professionally or recreationally, with the ability to deconstruct, analyze and synthesize market trends across data and personal experience lenses
A data-informed strategic thinker who is able to balance business priorities, customer perspective, resources, capacity, and partner needs to drive clear decisions.
Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative, alignment-building approach that emphasizes influence, clarity, and shared understanding
Strong understanding of service-based products and methodologies, including drivers of performance, player needs/sensitivities and content models.
Able to thrive in ambiguous environments and enjoy creating clarity
Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments, proactively identifying risks and opportunities early and working to mitigate issues before they become problems

Experience working on multiplayer competitive games in Product Management, Game Design, Production, Insights, or Strategy

Our portfolio features iconic, critically acclaimed franchises across multiple platforms and genres, including 
NBA 2K
, 
WWE 2K
, 
PGA TOUR 2K
, 
BioShock
,

.
At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive, highly collaborative environment where world-class talent can Come as You Are and do their best work. We are dedicated to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we encourage candidates of all backgrounds to explore our global opportunities.
What We Need
As part of our Central User Research organization that serves all of 2K, we are seeking a highly experienced, deeply passionate 
Senior User Researcher
 to drive end-to-end user research planning, execution, and stakeholder partnerships in service of our industry-leading Sports Business Unit.
In this role, domain user research expertise and a genuine passion for sports are core to success. Our central UR team has an incredible pipeline of high-impact, innovative work on the horizon across our flagship sports titles. We need a Senior Individual Contributor who lives and breathes sports media, interactive entertainment, sports gaming, and sports culture - someone who can translate fandom, gaming enthusiasm, and athletic mechanics into world-class player experiences.
We are looking for a top-tier user research practitioner who brings proactive communication, immaculate organizational discipline, and a consultative mindset. You excel at building trust with game developers, studio heads, and publishing leaders, managing competing studio priorities with calm composure, and leading high-impact qualitative and quantitative studies independently. Because our development studios, research labs, and vendor partners are globally distributed, regular hands-on presence is key - expect domestic and international travel roughly once per month.
What You Will Do
1. End-to-End Study Planning & Hands-on Execution
Lead User Research Execution:
 Onboard rapidly to design, execute, and deliver high-priority user research studies for upcoming sports title milestones. Conduct hands-on study design, moderation, usability analysis, and report delivery across all phases of development.
Maintain Methodological Rigor:
 Serve as a subject matter expert who leads by example, applying best-in-class qualitative and quantitative user research techniques, study protocols, and actionable user experience synthesis to elevate game design quality across our portfolio.
Bridge Sports & UR:
 Leverage your deep knowledge of sports culture, sports broadcasting/media, and interactive gaming to ask the right questions and decode how fans evaluate fun and immersion in games.
2. Proactive Stakeholder Partnership & Strategic Alignment
Be a Proactive Communication Lead:
 Establish consistent, forward-looking communication rhythms with studio leadership, Executive Producers, and Directors across multiple titles and teams. Anticipate user research needs weeks before major production milestones rather than reacting to incoming tickets.
Bridge Communication & Build Consensus:
 Translate complex UR methodologies and player insights into clear, high-impact business and game design recommendations for cross-functional partners. Champion the player’s voice with patience, nuance, diplomacy, and clarity.
Integrate & Educate:
 Embed deeply within game development roadmaps to ensure user research is a seamless, friction-free input at key design, interface, production, and greenlight decisions.
3. Participant Sampling, Resourcing & Prioritization
Drive Relevant Sports Sampling Strategy:
 Ensure all qualitative and quantitative user research studies are powered by appropriate player demographics, behavioral profiles, and sports fandom levels. Oversee candidate screening criteria, recruitment pipelines, and sample validity to represent core, casual, and prospective player segments.
Manage Project Trade-Offs:
 Act as a thoughtful, objective filter between incoming high-velocity studio requests and available research capacity. Balance immediate hands-on study needs against overarching team roadmaps, offering lean/scrum research alternatives when constraints demand it.
Manage Budgets & Vendor Ecosystems:
 Oversee relationships with external research agencies, specialized sports recruitment vendors, and testing facilities. Negotiate scopes, hold vendors to high methodological standards, and scale research operations smoothly.
What Success Looks Like in 90 Days
30 Days:
 Onboard rapidly, audit active sports studio roadmaps, build rapport with primary studio leadership, and take direct ownership of immediate, high-priority sports user research studies.
60 Days:
 Deliver high-impact user research findings on critical imminent projects, refine sports participant recruitment strategies to ensure proper sample quality across fan profiles, and establish a clear roadmap for upcoming research initiatives.
90 Days:
 Serve as a trusted strategic partner across our Sports titles - owning end-to-end research execution, vendor operations, and study delivery while setting a high bar for sports UR excellence across 2K.
Who We Believe Would Be an Excellent Fit
The Sports & Media Enthusiast:
 You follow sports culture, sports broadcasting, sports media/entertainment platforms, and sports gaming closely. You understand what makes a sports experience feel authentic, fun, intuitive, and thrilling to different levels of fans.
The Expert Practitioner:
 You are a senior individual contributor who loves the craft of user research - from writing test plans and moderating lab sessions to running surveys and crafting compelling executive presentations.
The Sampling & Research Strategist:
 You understand that great user research depends on testing with the right target audience. You have proven instincts for participant criteria, screening, and driving representative sampling across diverse player cohorts.
The Exceptional Communicator:
 You default to over-communicating context early, flagging operational delays before they become blockers, and tailoring your message seamlessly to developers, designers, or executives.
Highly Organized Operator:
 You run on structure, systems, and clear documentation. You thrive when managing multiple moving parts across time zones, recruitment channels, active studies, and partner studios.
Qualifications & Background
Hands-on User Research Expertise:
 5+ years of direct, hands-on experience in User Research, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or User Experience design, with a proven ability to design, execute, and present end-to-end qualitative and quantitative user studies independently.
Sports Industry / Media Focus:
 Demonstrated passion for and professional experience or background in sports, sports media, sports gaming, or related entertainment/media industries.
Proven Capabilities in Relevant Sampling:
 Demonstrated experience setting participant criteria, designing screener logic, and managing participant recruitment pipelines to ensure robust, representative sample groups across diverse player segments.
Methodological Breadth:
 Deep proficiency in user research / UX methods (usability testing, interface analysis, survey design, diary studies, focus groups, playtesting, heuristic evaluations).
Vendor & Resource Management:
 Demonstrated experience managing project budgets, external research agencies, recruitment vendors, and multi-project research roadmaps.
Travel Requirement:
 Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately once per month (~25% travel) to visit partner development studios, oversee external lab studies, and engage with key stakeholders.
Education:
 Degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Psychology, Behavioral Economics, Human Factors, Statistics, or equivalent practical experience.
Bonus Points / Preferred
Deep familiarity with AAA Console/PC sports games, live-service titles, or free-to-play ecosystems.
Hands-on experience working directly in sports broadcast production, sports digital media, or interactive sports entertainment.
Experience navigating operational systems/dashboards (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Airtable) to streamline multi-project tracking.
Hands-on experience with UX/UXR tools and analytics suites (e.g., Qualtrics, Tableau, SPSS/R, SQL, or telemetry analysis).

Piloter

vérifiant

Diriger

en amont

Lancer et diriger
 des projets internes visant à améliorer la cohérence, l'automatisation et l'évolutivité de la localisation dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

 d'expérience en localisation, en coordination de production, en assurance qualité ou dans des domaines connexes du jeu vidéo ou des médias.

de façon autonome

Maîtrise
 des outils et des flux de travail de localisation (par exemple : TMS, outils de TAO, Jira, CMS, Confluence, etc.), avec la capacité de les optimiser.
Compréhension approfondie
 des principes d'internationalisation ou des processus de certification des fabricants.
Maîtrise parfaite ou quasi parfaite
 du chinois simplifié et excellentes compétences en communication en anglais.
Une approche proactive
 de la résolution de problèmes, axée sur le repérage des enjeux potentiels avant qu'ils n'affectent le pipeline.

À titre de coordonnateur·rice de localisation, vous évoluerez à l'intersection de la langue, de la production et de la technologie, en veillant à ce que la langue que vous prenez en charge soit représentée avec précision et soin. Who We Are
2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, 31st Union, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.
Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of 2K’s portfolio currently includes several AAA, sports and entertainment brands, including global powerhouse NBA®️ 2K,  renowned BioShock®️, Borderlands®️, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization®️ and XCOM®️ brands; popular WWE®️ 2K and WWE®️ SuperCard franchises, TopSpin 2K25, as well as the critically and commercially acclaimed PGA TOUR®️ 2K
At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We encourage ALL applicants to explore our global positions, even if they don’t meet every requirement for the role.  If you're interested in the job and think you have what it takes to work at 2K, we encourage you to apply!
What we need
2K’s Partnerships and Licensing team works across several disciplines to lead our partnerships with industry-leading First Party partners like Sony, Microsoft, Nintendo, Steam, and Epic to drive successful title publishing, brand integrations and go-to-market operations while working cross-functionally to ensure go-to-market excellence across all workflows. Our team culture is fast-paced, global and goal-oriented with a focus on driving revenue and exposure for our games worldwide. We hire self-starters who work hard and get the job done.
We are seeking an extremely organized and detail-oriented individual who can work closely with our First Party partners and internal stakeholders to successfully lead publishing and partner operations as the Console Account Manager (Microsoft, Sony, Nintendo). The ideal candidate should be highly cross-functional, excellent at partner operations and relations, and be experienced with both long-term planning and day-to-day execution. You will be the cross-functional lead for many contexts and with many teams: Product, Production, Marketing, Commercial, Sales, Go-to-Market, Operations, Legal and others. This work can also include First Party deal execution and compliance across 2K internal teams. This role will require you to own and lead projects at multiple levels of seniority, embracing a constantly changing environment and multitasking on numerous high-level projects at once while remaining cool, calm and collected.
 
What you'll do 
Lead First Party Relationships & Growth:
 Manage day-to-day relationships and operational alignment with Console First Party platform account teams, evaluating, evangelizing, and executing new platform technologies and growth opportunities.
Support Launch & Release Operations:
 Serve as the primary business point of contact for Console First Party platforms for game launches, pre-orders, and title releases to guarantee accurate, on-time delivery while keeping global stakeholders aligned.
Serve as Platform Subject Matter Expert:
 Maintain deep internal documentation on platform features, guidelines, and policies to educate internal teams, leveraging title and company performance data to advocate for platform-level process and policy improvements.
Execute Joint Strategic Data Initiatives:
 Collaborate cross-functionally to aggregate, analyze, and present regular product and business performance data to platform partners to advance shared business goals.
Drive Cross-Departmental Problem Solving:
 Partner across Product, Production, Marketing, Commercial, Sales and Legal to resolve roadblocks and ensure operational consistency and efficiency across all titles.
Who we think will be a great fit
4-6 years of project/product management, production experience and/or operations experience with tangible go-to-market results
Experience leading time-sensitive projects in a highly matrixed and cross-functional organization working with globally distributed teams in multiple time zones globally. Must be equally fluent in IRL, Zoom, Slack and email
Passion for video games and game development
Ability to communicate effectively, with strong oral and written skills
